name: croatia-travel-site
description: Static travel website for Croatia. Brand, contact details and palette live in site.config.mjs.

scripts.build: node scripts/check-contrast.mjs && node build.mjs && node scripts/i18n.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/check-contrast.mjs && node build.mjs && node scripts/i18n.mjs && node scripts/i18n.mjs check
scripts.dev: node build.mjs && node scripts/i18n.mjs && node scripts/serve.mjs
scripts.cf-pages: npm run build && cp cloudflare/_headers dist/
